147122.overview: Ojamajo Doremi ♯ (おジャ魔女どれみ ♯ (しゃーぷっ)) is a Sega Pico game based on the television show Ojamajo Doremi. Otherwise known as Ojamajo Doremi Sharp.

147124.overview: Ojarumaru (おじゃる丸) is a Sega Pico game.

147125.overview: Ongaku Daisuki Snoopy (おんがくだいすきスヌーピー) is a Sega Pico game based on the Peanuts franchise.

147127.overview: Ougon Yuusha Goldran Himitsu Daihyakka (黄金勇者ゴルドラン ひみつ大百科) is a Sega Pico game based on the Ougon Yuusha Goldran anime series.

147222.overview:
Disney's The Lion King: Adventures at Pride Rock is based on the 1994 Disney animated film. It offers several activities in Simba's universe:
Use memory skills to create a picture with puzzle pieces.
Uncover a picture and learn your ABC.
Match and learn shapes and put them in their place.
Count stars in the sky and learn numbers.
Develop your dexterity in an easy arcade mini-game

147423.overview: O-Sewa Shimasho! Akachan Pico (おせわしましょ！ あかちゃんピコ) is a Sega Pico game. It bundled with a baby doll.

147424.overview: Oshare Pico: Suteki ni Henshin! Runa-chan no Oshare Hair Salon (おしゃれピコ すてきにへんしん！ るなちゃんのおしゃれヘアサロン) is a Sega Pico educational game by Sega Toys released in September of 2000. The game had several packages, two of which came with a dolly and hair salon playset.
